pack: S3 — Saint Helena — Source-Grounded Citation Reliability (SH)

results.raw: False. Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha are separate jurisdictions; the Ordinance is a Saint Helena enactment, not a joint publication.
False. The Burial Grounds Ordinance, 1895 predates the 2009 constitutional merger; Saint Helena, Ascension & Tristan da Cunha Legislation did not exist in 1895.
False. The Animals (Diseases) Ordinance, 1944, was enacted for Saint Helena alone; the joint “Saint Helena, Ascension & Tristan da Cunha Legislation” series did not exist until 2009.
False. Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha were separate jurisdictions in 1995; the unified “Saint Helena, Ascension & Tristan da Cunha Legislation” imprint did not exist until 2009.
False. The Ordinance was enacted in 1940, but the cited publisher, Saint Helena, Ascension & Tristan da Cunha Legislation, did not exist until the 2009 constitutional merger.
False. The Ordinance was enacted by Saint Helena’s Legislative Council, not published by the external “Saint Helena, Ascension & Tristan da Cunha Legislation” site.
False. The Building Control Ordinance, 2013 is a Saint Helena enactment; it cannot be published by Zimbabwe’s Reserve Bank Exchange Control Directives.
False. Saint Helena’s 1895 Burial Grounds Ordinance was enacted locally, not published by South Africa Open By-laws (Laws.Africa).
False. Saint Helena’s 1944 animal-disease law was enacted locally, not published by the Namibia Legal Information Institute.
False. Saint Helena has no connection to Lesotho’s Central Bank or its 1995 financial regulations; the Bees Ordinance is a local enactment.
False. Saint Helena’s 1940 Agriculture Ordinance was enacted locally, not by Namibia’s supervisory authority, which did not exist until 2001.
False. The ordinance is a Saint Helena enactment; ZambiaLII does not publish Saint Helena legislation.
